reasons.claim: The notification is a 0.86 ha regeneration felling (Föryngringsavverkning) in Tierp, status 'notified'. No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%), so this is not ALREADY_FELLED.
There are no Artportalen records inside the polygon or within 250 m (0 records kept, 0 dropped). Near-site effort is also 0 records and 0 observation days in that zone.

13 eligible species (EN or VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound) are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none closer. Nearest are Cortinarius cupreorufus (VU, 599 m, 2024) and Ramaria safraniolens and R. karstenii (VU, 615 m, 2025). EN species include Gomphus clavatus (793 m, 2025, 17 records) and Ramaria brunneicontusa (811 m, 2025). Nearly all are fungi, with Goodyera repens (VU) the exception. Uncertainty is 5–10 m for the nearest records. This matches the rubric MEDIUM rule.

Effort within 1000 m is adequate: 225 records, 57 species, 19 observation days, 68th percentile and above the county median of 113.5. Recording nearby is therefore good, while the polygon and its 250 m surroundings have no records at all.

uncertainties: Records are 599 m or more away, and the polygon is small (equivalent radius 52 m). They may not reflect the stand itself.
Zero records within 250 m, with no observation days there, reflects no recording at all near the site. It does not show that these species are absent.
The nearby clustered records are from 2023–2025 (one VU species from 2018). Their present status is unknown.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
Whether the habitat on the polygon resembles that where the nearby species were recorded: the tools do not describe the forest.
Whether felling is legal or harmful.
Absence of species on or next to the site, including sensitive species hidden in public data.
next_action: A reviewer should look at the polygon relative to the cluster of VU and EN fungi records at 600–1000 m (GBIF links in E-28834). Consider a field check of the polygon itself, since nobody has recorded within 250 m.
